name: one arm towel row
description: A one-arm bodyweight row with a towel securely anchored in front of you, training the upper back and grip.
instructions: Anchor a towel securely at about chest height and grip one end with one hand.
Step back and lean away from the anchor with your feet planted and knees softly bent.
Pull your chest toward the towel by driving your elbow back while keeping your hips stable.
Extend the arm slowly to lean back again, then switch sides after the set.
